purpose: Use one daily nostalgia slot to broaden audience relevance without selecting obscure titles only because rights are easy.

public_segment_branding.note: The editorial mood may evoke afternoon-TV nostalgia, but the official Cena Certa segment should not imply affiliation with a broadcaster or third-party program brand.

daily_mix_rule.outside_range_exception: Only for exceptionally iconic titles with strong current demand and a legal visual route.

signals: SEARCH_INTEREST: meaningful recent or evergreen search demand
COMMUNITY_CONVERSATION: relevant discussion/rewatch intent in forums or communities such as Reddit, Letterboxd or equivalent public sources
CULTURAL_RECALL: strong franchise, character, actor or quote recognition
CURRENT_AVAILABILITY: legally available in Brazil on a mainstream streaming, rental, purchase or theatrical route
REWATCH_SIGNAL: comments, lists, rankings or audience discussion indicating desire to revisit the title

network_strategy.rule: Treat age distribution as a working audience hypothesis and validate with platform analytics rather than assume it as universal fact.
network_strategy.facebook: Lean nostalgia slightly heavier when performance supports it.
network_strategy.instagram: Mix nostalgia with current major titles and visually strong franchises.
network_strategy.tiktok: Use faster hooks and stronger recognizable concepts; nostalgia only when title recognition or rediscovery is evident.
network_strategy.youtube: Keep the same core video but optimize title/description for discovery and rewatch intent.
